summary: The busiest week on this account all quarter (92 messages, 67 of them from Lilia) and the most volatile. It opened badly: she flagged chatters underpricing full-length explicit content three separate times on Aug 28 alone, then on Aug 29 said she had lost a high spender and roughly $300 because nobody passed on a fan request - a near-identical repeat of the Jul 29 incident Fred promised on Jul 30 to fix. Neither the Aug 28 evening message nor the whole Aug 29 sequence was ever answered by Fred, despite three Mayson escalations. The week then turned: her highest spender Teddi came back on Aug 30 (she won him back herself), and from Aug 30 onward Fred engaged properly for the first time in weeks - he paused the chat team twice rather than push without her, agreed on Aug 31 to route every custom through her for approval after chatters pushed a $750 whipped-cream custom she had previously refused, and started building Teddi's CRM notes. She ended the week thanking him and reporting real revenue. Underneath, the stale-promise stack barely moved: her two Aug 26 instructions (share-for-shares, sexting-set repricing) are still unanswered nine days on, the accepted $100/min shower custom is 24 days silent, the reselling chatter has still never been named (42 days), the $192 ledger gap is unreconciled, and TikTok went the entire week without a single message from anyone - Vivek has been silent for 11 days on a job that is now 17 days old. The Aug 15-31 invoice arrived Sept 3, two days later than the usual 1st-of-month cadence and with no advance 'invoicing will start tomorrow' reminder.

health.rationale: Up from 58, but fragile, and it is an up on trajectory rather than on outcome. This week contains ALTR's worst single result on the account - she says she lost a high spender and about $300 because chatters did not communicate (Aug 29), the second such loss in a month (Jul 29), and she got no reply at all. Against that: Teddi, her highest spender, is back and being monetised at $200+; Fred's conduct from Aug 30 onward is a genuine step change (paused the team twice before pushing, asked her before acting on a custom and on a call request, started CRM notes) and she said so herself - 'Thanks for communicating' (Sep 2) and 'We made good money in the last two days! Yayyy!' (Sep 2). She is still doing ALTR's job for it, though: 59 assets uploaded and filed into the high-spender folder by her, and Teddi recovered by her. The score is capped by four things that did not move at all: the two Aug 26 instructions still unanswered, the never-named reselling chatter (42 days), the abandoned TikTok workstream (17 days, zero mentions this week), and the unreconciled $192.
